verdict.rationale: Atlas's own docs say which state it covers (Delaware C corps, LLCs, and C corp subsidiaries) and which filings it handles (incorporation, the EIN via Form SS-4, 83(b) elections, and a Delaware registered agent). The pack has no first-party pricing; the $500 figure comes only from community comments. Nothing documents whether annual-report or franchise-tax filings are covered, and users note that home-state foreign registration and state-level legwork are left to them. Missing for 10: first-party pre-purchase pricing, a stated scope for annual-report and franchise-tax filings, explicit disclosure of filings and states not covered, and independent corroboration of how pricing is disclosed.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the filing service states which filings and states it covers and what it costs before I buy it

citations.quote: Stripe Atlas supports forming Delaware C corporations, limited liability companies (LLCs), and C corporation subsidiaries.
Atlas automatically gets your EIN by filing Form SS-4 with the IRS.
Atlas automatically files 83(b) elections for all founders
Satisfy Delaware compliance requirements with a registered agent.
